summary: Structure bias with range filter, 8/21 trend ribbon, 200 EMA, context dots, support and resistance zones and a status panel.
overview: This community script reads market structure and shows a simple state: follow the trend, wait, or stay out of the chop. It draws a fast and slow trend ribbon (8 and 21 by default), a 200 EMA, colored momentum candles and small context dots.

It also marks structure levels with labels, SBS triangles at liquidity rejections, up to three dynamic support and resistance zones, and a status panel with the current phase. An optional table shows the state on four other timeframes.
how: Structure uses two causal swing lengths: a primary (outer) swing of 2 and a local swing of 1. A break is accepted after one close beyond the level. A pullback counts as orderly if it retraces no more than 0.618 of the leg; two local breaks against the primary trend put it on turn watch.

A range is declared after four local flips within 30 bars when the range is no wider than 3.5 ATR; two closes outside end it. Exhaustion dots use RSI(14) above 75 or below 25 and a stretch of 2 ATR from the ribbon. Support and resistance zones come from pivots of strength 15.
use: Use the status panel to see whether structure is aligned, pulling back or turning.
Some traders stand aside while the range filter is active.
Watch the exhaustion dots when price is stretched far from the ribbon.
Use the multi-timeframe table to compare the state across timeframes.
alerts: Alerts: members can create an alert on its conditions (for example "Stoic Edge Compass - Green", "Stoic Edge Compass - Red", "Stoic Edge Compass - Range Established", "Stoic Edge Compass - SBS Bullish") from the chart's alert dialog; alerts from indicators run while ZoroCharts is open in the browser.
notes: On Heikin Ashi charts it can use standard OHLC for its logic.
The multi-timeframe table needs extra data requests and is off by default.
